description: This file defines a controller class 'PaymentMethod' in the OpenCart system responsible for handling checkout payment methods, including displaying payment options, validating payment selection, saving payment data, and handling comments and agreement updates.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Controller class managing checkout payment methods in OpenCart, including rendering payment options, validating and saving user selections, and handling comments and agreements.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the payment method selection view with current session data and informational text.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Validates cart and session data, retrieves available payment methods, and returns them as a JSON response.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates payment method selection, updates session data accordingly, and confirms success or errors.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Stores user comments related to the order and updates the order record.

methods.name: agree
methods.description: Sets or unsets the user's agreement status for checkout terms in session data.
